name: Cuervo Home Solutions, LLC

reviews.author: Jeri Klare
reviews.text: I am so happy to find a home maintenance company that does great work at an affordable price. I highly recommend Cuervo Home Solutions. They installed closet doors, fixed a lighting issue, mounted a wall TV and took care of a plumbing problem. As a senior citizen I appreciate when a job gets done right the first time.

reviews.author: Edward Wrage
reviews.text: I highly recommend Cuervo Home Solutions for your handyman, home repairs and renovation projects. They perform very high quality work at very reasonable prices. They use high quality materials that will last in our Florida weather.

reviews.author: Daniel Intagliata
reviews.text: I've had Karen and Luc help with several odd jobs around the house including painting my door and cabinets. They are both responsive, friendly, and they always make sure that I'm satisfied with the result. I highly recommend CHS!

reviews.author: guy nichols
reviews.text: I've worked with Luc and Karen of Cuervo Home Solutions several times over the past few weeks during my renovation, and they've been terrific. Luc has helped with a wide range of carpentry and detail work from weatherproofing and furring to other tasks.

reviews.author: Matt Schuck
reviews.text: Luc, Cody, and Karen are true professionals at their craft. We began working with them several years ago with our Christmas Light installation, as many of the people on our street do. Phenomenal in every aspect.

services_summary: Family-run handyman and remodeling crew doing fencing, decks, pergolas, renovation, painting, Christmas light installation and property/cleaning upkeep in St. Petersburg, FL.
